name: Happy Weekend
original_name: ハッピーウィークエンド
source:
College life――Studying, exercising, dating, working part-time, the only period where you can do anything you like. In this moratorium period, the protagonist, Yamabuki Minato is enjoying his freedom. He would drink, hang out, study, worry, and fell in love as well, but he begins to have doubt about living each day indecisively.

In the spring of his third year, by raising his awareness a little, he realizes that he have had a few encounters.
"A freshman who has been helping him."
"A woman he met at a group date."
"A regular at his part-time."
And......"An old acquaintance in an ambiguous relationship."

Determined, for the protagonist who decides to act, what route lies ahead――?

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.hook-net.jp/weekend/]official website[/url]]
translation:
大学生活——学习、锻炼、恋爱、打工，唯一可以做自己喜欢的事情的时期。在这个暂停期间，主人公山吹凑享受着自由。他会喝酒、闲逛、学习、担心，也会恋爱，但他开始对犹豫不决的每一天感到怀疑。

高三春天，觉悟稍稍提高，才发现自己有过一些遭遇。
“一个一直在帮助他的新生。”
“他在一次集体约会中认识的一个女人。”
“兼职的常客。”
还有……“关系暧昧的老熟人。”

决定了，决定行动的主角，前方的路是什么——？

[翻译编辑自[url=https://www.hook-net.jp/weekend/]官网[/url]]
